summary: SNDL Inc., a Canadian vertically integrated cannabis and liquor retailer, filed a Form 6-K on August 4, 2026, attaching a press release announcing the successful completion of an EU-GMP audit at its Atholville, New Brunswick cultivation facility. The audit validates operational excellence and supports international medical cannabis expansion; certification is expected within 90 days. No financial terms, transactions, or special situations are involved. The filing is a routine operational update regarding regulatory compliance.
